description: The registry record of one name: dates, registrar, status codes, nameservers, DNSSEC and holder. Use it when someone asks who holds a name, which registrar it is at, when it was registered or when it expires: the record a WHOIS lookup shows. Pass `name` (such as get.plumbing).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: read, createdAt, updatedAt, expiresAt, registrar, eppStatuses, nameservers, dnssec, holder.

name.description: A full domain name on an ending in the catalog, such as harbor.io: lowercase, an internationalized name as punycode. A bare word, a subdomain, an email address or an unknown ending is refused with the reason, and a suggestion when there is one.

name: ud_get_name_registry

dataset.description: The GitHub dataset holding the same rows.

details.description: The public Unique.domains page about the subject.

next.description: The next page on the API, when there is one.

title: Registry record of one name
